scope: LIBERO-10 GR00T Joint PPO round 2: up to three single-factor fused AdamW (fp32_master, lr 1e-6, native profile) trials against policy log-prob drift
base: feat/quantized-optimizers @ 94f532c8 (includes the Joint PPO memory fix)

code.a89c4509: opt-in model.ppo_reference_kl_beta: frozen FSDP2 copy of the source action head outside .net; exact Gaussian KL of the scored selected transition added to the joint loss; default 0 keeps native behaviour, metrics and identity
code.42be1d6b: trainer reports reference_kl in window metrics for anchored models
code.tests: test_algorithm_joint_ppo_reference_kl.py (6) plus affected joint PPO / GR00T suites: 50+ passing locally

trials.name: A: reference KL beta 10
trials.mechanism: holds (KL ratio 1.61) but KL still rising

not_run.C_target_kl: Per-window policy change is tiny (ratio_mean ~1.0008, PPO clip fraction ~0.3%); an approx-KL early stop would rarely fire and cannot bound the cumulative drift seen in every run. Predicted no effect.
not_run.C_logprob_scale: The log-prob sums 8x7 = 56 cells of one denoising transition, but AdamW plus global-norm clipping (which binds on every update) are invariant to a constant loss scale; per-dimension normalization predicts no change in update magnitude, and normalizing inside the ratio would only loosen PPO clipping further. Predicted no effect.
not_run.decision: Third admitted trial not spent: both remaining candidates have predeclared no-effect mechanisms.

conclusion: No fused AdamW recipe on LIBERO-10 met the stop condition (bar through 320 AND a real gain). The KL anchor converts collapse into a stable-but-non-improving baseline (trial A); its early gains (+3 to +3.5 points at update 80 in both anchored runs) are not retained. Protocol not locked; no fused-vs-8-bit, equal-resource, time-to-target or paged/nonpaged LIBERO-10 recovery runs were admitted.
observations_for_next_round: Both anchored runs peak at update 80 (0.945, 0.935; tasks 8+9 33, 32). A fixed-exposure recipe that stops at 80 updates is a candidate, but the target must be chosen from development data and validated on several seeds.

Trained-policy evaluation noise on the 200 aligned cases is ~4-5 points within a run, far above the +/-1 point frozen-checkpoint estimate; the final protocol needs >=3 seeds, paired cluster bootstrap and possibly the larger shared_500 profile to resolve gains of a few points.
Actor grad norm (~40-65) is clipped to 1.0 on every update; the update direction is dominated by high-variance log-prob gradients, and Adam normalization limits what a loss-space anchor can restrain.
